readme: Labelled narrative corpus for the citation-check evaluation. Each entry pairs a narrative with the fact values it was checked against, a ground-truth 'faithful' label (does the narrative avoid fabricated or misattributed numeric claims?), and the pinned checker verdict. Classes cover the checker's documented blind spots (fn-*), its documented over-flagging routes (fp-*), plain fabrications it must catch, and faithful narratives it must pass. Aggregate results are published in docs/narrative-evidence-v1.md; the enrichment_citation_corpus_test asserts both the per-entry verdicts and the published totals, so corpus edits and doc edits must land together. Entries are authored against the fact-sheet schema in enrichment/fact_sheet.rs; append model-generated entries with source "model:<id>" as they are collected.
